lit-review.prompt_template: Read AGENTS.md and src/scieflow/research/AGENTS.md, then run the lit-review workflow (src/scieflow/research/skills/lit-review/SKILL.md) on: <subject>. Use workspace slug `<slug>`. Start with the run configuration gate and confirm staffing with me.

gap-discovery.ask: Field or question to find gaps in
gap-discovery.prompt_template: Read AGENTS.md and src/scieflow/research/AGENTS.md, then run the gap-discovery workflow (src/scieflow/research/skills/gap-discovery/SKILL.md) on: <subject>. Use workspace slug `<slug>`. Start with the run configuration gate and confirm staffing with me.

paper-review.ask: Manuscript to review (path) and target journal
paper-review.prompt_template: Read AGENTS.md and src/scieflow/research/AGENTS.md, then run the paper-review workflow (src/scieflow/research/skills/paper-review/SKILL.md) on: <subject>. Use workspace slug `<slug>`. Start with the run configuration gate and confirm staffing with me.

paper-draft.ask: What to draft from (a finished run slug, or a topic)
paper-draft.prompt_template: Read AGENTS.md and src/scieflow/research/AGENTS.md, then run the paper-draft workflow (src/scieflow/research/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md) on: <subject>. Use workspace slug `<slug>`. Start with the run configuration gate and confirm staffing with me.

research-loop.ask: Research question / goal for the loop
research-loop.prompt_template: Read AGENTS.md, then follow skills/research-loop/SKILL.md to start a new research run. Goal: <subject>. Use workspace slug `<slug>`. Draft goal.md with me and ask me for the approval mode before initialising the run.

experiment-design.ask: What the experiment campaign should test
experiment-design.prompt_template: Read AGENTS.md and src/scieflow/experiments/AGENTS.md. Using src/scieflow/experiments/skills/experiment-designer/SKILL.md, propose an experiment campaign for: <subject>. Record runs under workspace/<slug>/experiments. Do not run anything before I approve it.

systematic-review.ask: Review question for the systematic review
systematic-review.prompt_template: Read AGENTS.md and src/scieflow/research/AGENTS.md, then run the systematic-review workflow (src/scieflow/research/skills/systematic-review/SKILL.md) on: <subject>. Use workspace slug `<slug>`. Start with the run configuration gate and confirm staffing with me.

default.title: All projects (ScieFlow defaults)
default.effect: Writes config/agents.yml and config/defaults.yml. Every run without its own override follows it.

workspace.title: One workspace only
workspace.effect: Writes workspace/<slug>/config.yml. Only that run changes; it stores just the differences from the defaults.

news.title: News only
news.effect: Writes config/news.yml. Affects `scieflow news` and nothing else.

loop.experiment.help: experiment-cycle sub-agent: campaign design and run

research.draft-reviewers.help: paper-draft reviewer pool (default: the draft authors)

research.sr-screeners.help: systematic-review dual screeners (exactly two primary agents)

apply_with.default: uv run scieflow agent configure --assign ROLE=AGENT --set AGENT.FIELD=VALUE --yes
apply_with.workspace: uv run scieflow agent configure --workspace <slug> --assign ROLE=AGENT --set AGENT.FIELD=VALUE --yes
apply_with.news: uv run scieflow agent configure --news --set FIELD=VALUE --yes

resume_prompt_template: Read AGENTS.md. Resume the research run workspace/<slug>: read its status.yml and continue from the first phase not done, per skills/research-loop/SKILL.md.
